answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the vine of free entry disappears, the tundra of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the nebula case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
